# January Analysis

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
# filter for July temps
jan_data <- subset(temp_data, month == "Jan")
# fit a GLM model to see if there is a trend in Jul temps over time
jan_model <- glm(temp_C ~ year*site_no, data = jan_data)
summary(jan_model)
```
